hook.name: HookpotHook
hook.description: A lottery jackpot hook for an ETH/Hookpot token pool that collects a 1.5% fee on every swap into a prize pot. Eligible swaps earn weighted tickets based on native ETH trade value; at round end a random weighted winner is selected (requiring minimum token holding) and paid 50–80% of the pot, with the remainder rolling over to the next round. Super rounds (every 10–50 rounds) pay out 99%.
